title: Studying with Professor Monetta and brass bands seen in the city
summary: The man says he only fooled with music, studied across the river with Professor Monetta whose pupils played in brass bands, and saw brass bands in New Orleans rather than Napoleonville.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I used to fool around with it but I never did play it. I studied across the river from a fellow named Professor Monetta. Oh, I see. I know you, know his pupils. He taught quite a few things. They play in the brass band.
Where did the other fellows used to follow us? Your buddy went to Chicago. Did he ever come back?

Which one? Oh, the clarinet, he was clarinet player. Yeah. No, no, he lives up there now. Yeah. He used to be a radio announcer and be on television. Yeah, uh-huh. But he went up there. Yeah. When you were out as a young boy, you never saw brass bands around Napoleonville much, huh? Did you see any? Not Napoleonville.
I saw them mostly here. Mostly here, huh?
What brass bands do you remember from the city here?
